programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: En el bar Garibaldi, los mariachis hacen un homenaje por sus compañeros ausentes, Emiliano, Fernando y Rosario. Mientras tanto, Emiliano y Rosario hablan con un hombre, apodado el tigre, para que los ayude a cruzar la frontera.

programme.title: Leandro Díaz
programme.desc: Miriam le avisa a Arturo que Leandro está ahí, ella revela toda la trampa justo a tiempo.

programme.title: Leandro Díaz
programme.desc: Leandro desautoriza a Clementina frente a sus hijos, y ella entra en cólera. Moisés sigue viviendo en casa de Matilde Lina. Matilde le reproduce unas cintas que él mismo grabó para ubicarlo en la realidad.

programme.title: Leandro Díaz
programme.desc: Nacha se da mañas para convencer a Onofre de hacerles una guacharaca, Arturo se desespera con sus sobrinos, y envía un telegrama anónimo a sus papás para que los recojan.

programme.title: Leandro Díaz
programme.desc: Matilde y Leandro coinciden en que sus presentes aún los separan y se despiden. Ella reúne valor y regresa a decirle que aún lo quiere; le pide que lo piense y se vean en cinco días. Onofre no puede evitar que Arturo saque a sus nietos de la casa.

programme.title: Leandro Díaz
programme.desc: Toño y Matilde llevan a Moisés a un sitio de reposo. Matilde no logra cumplirle la cita a Leandro, pero envía a Zunilda. Él le manda a decir que no puede dejar a su familia. Leandro le cuenta todo a Clementina.

programme.title: Leandro Díaz
programme.desc: Leandro le pregunta a Dios cómo superar ese dolor, y su hijo Ivo le dice que con una canción; Leandro la compone y además le cumple la promesa a su hijo.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: El comandante Salas y la teniente Morales tienen en la mira a Emiliano, esperan el momento oportuno para capturarlo. Se arma una gran pelea entre Don Carlos y Anselmo. Emiliano, Fernando y Rosario logran escapar gracias al escándalo.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Rosario coge un taxi para llegar a San Roque. Arrestan a Fernando y lo llevan con el resto del grupo de mariachis. En la comandancia interrogan a todo el grupo. Mientras tanto, El Coloso y Emiliano hacen las paces y se despiden en San Roque.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Rosario logra alcanzar el bus en el que se transporta Emiliano. El capitán Bernal hace repartir un volante con la foto de Emiliano Sánchez Gallardo en la que ofrecen una recompensa de treinta millones de pesos.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Rosario y Emiliano se montan en un camión que los lleve a la frontera. En el camión van unos muchachos que le coquetean a Rosario, uno de ellos va armado. Mientras tanto, Raquel le pide a los mariachis que confiesen donde esta Rosario.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Fernando le explica a Raquel y a Javier Macías que Rosario se fue con Emiliano porque quiso, Emiliano no la obligo. Por otro lado, Fernando y Sigifredo planean la forma de enviarle dinero a Emiliano para que pueda cruzar la frontera.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: En el bar Garibaldi, los mariachis hacen un homenaje por sus compañeros ausentes, Emiliano, Fernando y Rosario. Mientras tanto, Emiliano y Rosario hablan con un hombre, apodado el tigre, para que los ayude a cruzar la frontera.

programme.title: Diomedes
programme.desc: Diomedes le dice a Lucia que van a hablar, habrá un toque donde estará Olarte, Diomedes habla con Hernán Urbina y le pide una composición. En el bar está Israel Osorio con una mujer, todos saben que es la mujer de un narco.

programme.title: Diomedes
programme.desc: En el bar está Israel Osorio con una mujer, todos saben que es la mujer de un narco, Diomedes le pide que se cuide, al momento llega el pluma blanca con el nene filo y se encuentra a su mujer con Israel Osorio y amenaza a quien se meta con su mujer.

programme.title: Diomedes
programme.desc: Lucia organiza una cena para Juancho y María Paula, allí están los papás de Lucia, al momento llega Joaco con la noticia que mataron a Israel Osorio, Diomedes se descompone y sube a su habitación.

programme.title: Diomedes
programme.desc: Lucia enfrenta a su mama dice que no es la primera vez que llegan cartas de mujeres. Joe llega a darle el pésame a Diomedes que está muy mal por la muerte de su amigo Israel Osorio.

programme.title: Diomedes
programme.desc: Juancho le pide matrimonio a María paula. Ena se opone a que ellos se casen porque para ella Juancho es poca cosa, Juancho canta una canción y les deja en claro que luchará por su amor que van a ser esposos pase lo que pase.

programme.title: Diomedes
programme.desc: Llega el matrimonio entre Juancho y Paula. Diomedes y Lucia siguen bravos, ella le promete que le hará pasar la peor noche de su vida. La fiesta de matrimonio sigue, María Paula le pide a Juancho que jamás sean como Diomedes y Lucia.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Emiliano y Rosario llegan a San Miguel y buscan al tigre, Emiliano confiesa que quiere viajar a Venezuela solo. Por otro lado, el comandante Salas se le declara a la teniente Morales y terminan haciendo el amor.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Emiliano se va dejando a Rosario en el hotel. El capitán Bernal llega al hotel donde se hospeda el comandante Salas y la teniente Morales para avisarles que Emiliano está en un pueblo llamado San Miguel. El tigre delata a Emiliano.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Andrés le avisa a Miguel Corona que cogieron a Emiliano y a su novia en Colombia. Por otro lado, Javier Macías visita a Rosario en la cárcel y le ofrece su servicio de abogado.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: El grupo de mariachis con Letty le dan una serenata a Emiliano en la cárcel. Todos los integrantes del grupo se despiden de Emiliano y le dejan una fotografía para que siempre los recuerde. Emiliano es deportado a México.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Emiliano Sanchez es llevado a la misma cárcel donde se encuentra Felipe Romero. Emiliano pide que su abogado sea Miguel Corona. Por otro lado, Rubén contrata un sicario de la cárcel para que asesine a Emiliano.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Ronald da la orden de matar a Emiliano para que no abra la boca. Emiliano le confiesa a Felipe toda la verdad. Por otro lado, Rosario saca las cosas de Emiliano de la pensión. La manada intenta consolar a Rosario con una serenata.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Rosario continúa destrozada por la noticia que recibió por parte de la policía y decide quedarse encerrada. Por otro lado, Emiliano alista el traje de mariachi para devolverlo. El mexicano renuncia en el bar diciendo que se va para su país.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Emiliano busca hospedaje en la calle de la laguna. Mientras tanto, Javier Macías busca un apartamento de lujo para alquilarlo. Por otro lado, Carlos Malagón le comunica a los mariachis que Emiliano renuncio, Fernando decide salir a buscarlo.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Fernando y Sigifredo deciden buscar a Emiliano en la calle de la Laguna, se llevaran una gran sorpresa al ver a Emiliano borracho cantando en un bar. Emiliano terminara confesándole a Sigifredo toda la verdad sobre su verdadera identidad.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Sigifredo habla con Raquel sobre el paradero de Emiliano, Lucia los oye a escondidas. Por otro lado, Roberto Sanchez decide visitar al licenciado Miguel Corona para comentarle que están sospechando de Emiliano por la muerte de Martin del Valle.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Fernando intenta explicarle a Sigifredo las razones por las que encubrió a Emiliano. Fernando insiste en sacar a Emiliano de la laguna pero este sigue negándose. Por otro lado, el Coloso aprovecha la situación en la que esta Rosario para consolarla.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Emiliano sale con los mariachis del Maguey a dar serenatas. Por otro lado, Fernando va a la laguna para avisarle a Emiliano que Gabriela envió un correo. Fernando dejara el mensaje con Memo, quien aprovechara para proponerle trabajo al mexicano.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Emiliano hace un pésimo arreglo con Memo para trabajar en el Maguey. El Mexicano cambiara canciones por comida y trago. Por otro lado, sin pensar y sin tener en cuenta las consecuencias, Lucia decide salir en busca de Emiliano.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Un triste e incómodo encuentro entre Emiliano y Rosario en el bar el Maguey. El dolor que siente Emiliano al ver partir a la mujer que ama con otro hombre, lo llevara a seguir cometiendo errores.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Emiliano se niega a aceptar que su relación con Rosario se acabe y por esto decide salir a buscarla. Por otro lado, Verónica llama a Virginia para contarle que Emiliano está trabajando en el bar el Maguey.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Con ayuda de Sigifredo, Emiliano recupera los cuadernos de Lucia y reúne el dinero para comprarle una maleta nueva. Por otro lado, Javier Macías quiere ofrecerle dinero a Emiliano para que regrese a México.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Javier Macías decide ofrecerle dinero a Emiliano para que regrese a su país y deje en paz a Rosario. El mexicano perderá el control y golpeara al cínico abogado sin medir las consecuencias.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Adoptando el papel de víctima, Javier Macías le confiesa a Rosario que Emiliano lo golpeo cuando él intentaba ayudarlo. Por otro lado, Emiliano decide llevar a Virginia a su horrible habitación para que salga despavorida y deje de acosarlo.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Golpes vienen y van. Emiliano continúa dando serenatas en compañía del Coloso de Jalisco y el grupo del Maguey. El Coloso usara su ingenio para convencer a Emiliano de ir con Rosario a la universidad y darle una serenata.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A disused airfield near Morton Fendle is the location for a romantic evening between young Simon Bright and his girlfriend Laura Sharp - absolutely nothing could ruin their date. The next morning, when Frances Kirby is out for her morning jog, she notices the vintage car they were in up at the airfield, containing Simon Bright's dead body, with Laura nowhere to be seen. Confused, Detective Chief Inspector Barnaby and D.S. Jones can't work out whether it was a suicide pact or murder. Furthermore, they've got to find Miss Sharp and their investigation leads them to linking Simon and Laura with the villagers of Morton Fendle, who met at Elaine Trim's dancing classes. Eventually, the Barnaby family plus Jones make it to a 40s style dance night at the village hall before more villagers start turning up dead.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When Faith Alexander arrives in Midsomer County to meet her long-lost uncle Rex Masters, she gets a shock - Rex's staff had been told that she was dead. Things become even more complex when Rex's body is found in a nearby river, bearing wounds that suggest he was murdered. Barnaby and Jones are soon on the case, trying to establish who would have wanted the elderly man dead. Several people soon come forward with multiple wills, which confuse the matter, but when two more people, close friends of Rex, are also murdered, the investigation raises question on the motive, leading Barnaby to wonder if it was down to finances, passion, or something from Rex's past.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Following the death of Alan King while on a business trip to China, the family company, King's Crystal, is in financial trouble. As plans to shut the Midsomer Magna factory are being put into action, Alan's wife Hilary and brother Charles are married in the village church - much to the dismay of Alan's son Ian. In addition to strife between members of the family, the factory workers are outraged at the loss of their jobs. So when company accountant Peter Baxter is found murdered, Barnaby and Jones suspect a disgruntled employee is to blame. But in order to investigate the matter further, Jones is forced to work undercover, and infiltrate the local group of Freemasons in the village.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The music lovers of Midsomer County are delighted when a host of bands arrives for the Midsomer Rocks festival. Barnaby himself is particularly looking forward to seeing recently re-formed rock band, Hired Gun, perform on stage, but he soon gets close to the band for rather unfortunate reasons. During their opening performance, the band's singer, Mimi (Suzi Quatro), falls to the ground dead - electrocuted by a wire that had been run through the microphone stand. Barnaby and Jones soon find the rest of the band could be targets, and when another is killed, questions are raised as to whether former band member, Ginger Foxton, who went missing for 30 years and is presumed dead, is still at large. The detectives soon have to delve into a world of rock music, drug use and greed, to find the truth.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The suspicious death of popular young GP Dr Alan Delaney brings Barnaby and Jones to Midsomer Market to investigate. The detectives are baffled as to a motive for murder - until they consider that the newly engaged Dr James Kirkwood may have been the intended victim. Before long, Barnaby and Jones are heading to Wales - former home to Delyth Mostyn, James's fiancee, to delve deeper into the mystery. There are certainly possible suspects in the murder and attempt on Kirkwood, from Delyth's children, who oppose the engagement, Delyth's husband, and more, as the detectives investigate things, in hopes of uncovering the truth before a major walk is to take place on Mount Snowdon.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: In the build-up to Luxton Deeping's annual photographic exhibition, a battle rages between the traditional and digital photographers of the pretty village. The dispute seems harmless enough - until Lionel Bell is found murdered in a nearby woodland, strangled with the cord of his light meter. Barnaby soon gets to work tracking down the killer, but it seems someone is trying to implicate the detective in the murder. And once he is replaced on the case, finding the culprit seems less likely than ever, as his replacement is more concerned of an upcoming wedding than the investigation. Barnaby is forced to work off the case to uncover who is framing him, and who wants dead other photographers in the village.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The residents of Midsomer Magna are thrilled when a production crew arrives at the local manor house to film a version of The Scarlet Pimpernel. But the crew members aren't the only visitors to the area - Jones has spotted notorious criminal George Ince nearby. But when the director, Nick Cheney, is found dead - his head severed by a prop guillotine - Barnaby must discover who would have wanted the victim dead. It soon becomes clear that things are not so simple, and the detectives soon have to shift through varying motives, layered by lies, hidden truths, and a possible robbery to be committed.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Barnaby is in Midsomer Holm, bidding farewell to reformed criminal Ronnie Tyler, who has taken part in a rehabilitation scheme in the village. Also present is disgraced ex-policeman Jack Colby, a former colleague of Barnaby's – but Jack refuses to talk to his old friend. When Jack is murdered, the detective must delve into the dark secrets in the victim's past. There are certainly dark secrets to uncover, and Barnaby has to determine whether the victim's part in a scandal years earlier at Causton police station, is key to the mystery behind his death. programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Water quality is everything—and the Star brite - SeaSafe team is back at it for the second year in a row! Led by Cory Redwine, Conservation Director of Project SeaSafe, this is the 4th Annual Clean Water Collective and it’s bigger than ever. This time, we’re in Grant, Florida, where 4 million clams are being released into the Indian River Lagoon, paired with the planting of thousands of mangroves, oyster work by CCA and trash clean ups to help restore one of Florida’s most critical ecosystems. But it’s not just about hard work—it’s about connection. With local captains, fishing legends, and the Local Knowledge crew on hand, we hit the water to show why this place is worth fighting for. From clam drops by drone, to in-water mangrove planting, to monster snook catches, this is hands-on conservation at its best. This two-part series kicks off with action, heart, and the kind of hope only a healthy waterway can bring. Don’t miss Part 1—where conservation meets community and everyone gets their hands wet.

programme.title: Eco-Heroines
programme.sub-title: Anna and the Thresher Sharks (The Philippines)
programme.desc: On the island of Malapascua in the Philippines, Anna Oposa and her team are working with local fisherman to create a nature reserve where thresher sharks can thrive. These sharks are famous for their long tails which they use to whip and stun their prey. Every day, pelagic thresher sharks head to Monad Shoal, a sunken island just off the coast of Malapascua, where other fish “clean” them of their external parasites. This remarkable sight is popular with divers but the numbers of thresher sharks are dwindling and Anna is spearheading the campaign to protect this incredible species in the Philippines.

programme.title: Eco-Heroines
programme.desc: Lorane is a young scientist dedicated to building shelters in the Franco-Swiss mountains for orphaned baby lynx, one of Europe's last great feline species and predators. Lynx are critical to the preservation and growth of Europe's habitats, playing a key role in the wider eco-system. programme.title: Don Friesen
programme.desc: Husband. Idiot. Dad. His kids think he's fun. His wife thinks he's an idiot. Audiences think he's hilarious! Don is a modern suburban dad just trying to raise his kids and get through the day with a bit of money in the bank and a scrap of dignity intact. With a unique style that can best be described as frenetic and engaging, Don captures the irony of parenting, marriage and everyday absurdities through characters, voices, parodies and some of the best written routines around. He's a wanna-be geek who constantly upgrades to the latest technology, but can never get it to work, leading to signature bits about tech support, Idiots Guides, texting and passwords. Friesen has recently taken his smart, savvy, and highly-caffeinated comedy to the stage at the Alex Theatre in Glendale, CA, for the taping of his new Showtime one-hour special titled "Ask Your Mom." In his first nationally released concert special, Don delivers a winning hour of clever, true-to-life "he's talking about my family up there" comedy that manages to be adult-smart yet family-friendly.

programme.title: Andy Peters
programme.desc: Andy Peters will get you. Where you sit, stand or hide. Wherever. Peters is a stand- up comedian who enjoys getting to the audience like no other. Along with his typically irreverent topics, he has the skills to go off script and still get the laughs. Fearless and often off-the-cuff. He won the Rocky Mountain Laugh-Off, was a Finalist in the Seattle International Comedy Competition and participated in the San Francisco Comedy Competition, Bridgetown and Just For Laughs Chicago Comedy Festival. Andy's debut Stand Up Special, Exclamation Mark Question Point is out now on Comedy Dynamics Film and A Special Thing Records. He can now also be seen as Coach Peters on the hit TruTV series Those Who Can't After years as a stand-out in the Seattle comedy scene, Peters now calls Los Angeles his home.

programme.title: Bone Hampton
programme.desc: As down home as collards and cornbread, as sharp as a pickaxe, and as funny as a possum in a petticoat, Comedian Bone Hampton is a master at making audiences feel like family. His clean, homespun humor, sharp wit, and easy delivery makes the Dove Award-winning "Comedian of the Year" one of the most highly sought after performers in the business. With more than 20 years in the game, his résumé is ever expanding with impressive stage and TV credits. The Texas native has logged countless appearances on ABC's "The View," including two stints as Guest Co-Host, and has served as personal gag writer for Actress/Comedienne Sherri Shepherd since 2010. He's also appeared on ABC's "Less Than Perfect," NBC's "My Name is Earl," BET's "Comic View," and the syndicated talk show Comics Unleashed with host Byron Allen. And yes, that is Bone in the very funny national commercial for Church's Chicken. No stranger to the big screen, Bone has appeared alongside Hollywood juggernaut Sandra Bullock in the romantic comedy "All About Steve," and can be seen in the film "Woodlawn" starring Sean Austin and Oscar winner Jon Voight. Bone took a leap of faith and moved to Los Angeles to pursue comedy full-time. Nothing could have prepared him for the culture shock that greeted him. Next to the hardcore acts he shared the stage with, his family-friendly routine seemed soft. But that fish-out-of-water experience inspired him to remain true to himself and to his God—no matter where he performed. He set out to carve out a niche all his own. (And carve he did!) In 2005, the Urban Gospel Alliance named him “Comedian of the Year.” His mission was simple—“I just like to have a good time. I just want to be the ringleader of the good time,” Bone says. Ask anyone who's ever seen Bone Hampton perform, they will tell you: Mission accomplished. Bone can be heard all day long on satellite radio, and caught on TV anytime your television is on.

Andrew was also featured on the popular Buzzfeed web series “Truth or Drink“, has performed in over 35 states and his new podcast called “Don't Quit Your Night Job” was featured in the Seattle Times.

programme.desc: "Franklin and Friends," based on the children's book series featuring Franklin, is a computer-animated series geared toward preschoolers that aims to teach the kids lessons. The series follows Franklin the turtle, now older than in the books and previous TV series, as he experiences adventures and achieves milestones in the community of Woodland, learning lessons along the way. Franklin's friends referenced in the title include best friend Bear, problem-solving Snail, practical joker Rabbit, natural leader Beaver, inventive Fox and empathetic Goose. The series tackles issues that include personal empowerment, socialization, self-esteem, appreciation of nature and school issues.

Rush Maltz reunites with his longtime friend, Captain Jeff Rella of Superfish Charters, to explore the deep drop fishery of the middle keys and Marathon. Together they target awesome species including queen snapper, barrel-fish, snowy grouper, and tilefish. programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: As April gets under way, Monty Don begins the process of reinvigorating his Jewel Garden where, over the coming months, he will be using plants which will give an evolving tapestry of colour over the seasons.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Spring gets into its stride and Longmeadow is bursting into life. Monty Don prepares for the summer by sowing hardy annual seed directly into the spring-warmed soil. Carol Klein visits The Gibberd Garden in Harlow.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: As spring gets well underway, Monty Don adds to his collection of fritillaries at Longmeadow with pot-grown plants, as well as sowing some from seed. He also recommends other wildflowers which would thrive in the garden.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: At Longmeadow, Monty gets going on planting climbing roses for different aspects in his walled garden. Continuing the theme of garden boundaries, this week Carol Klein is in her own garden at Glebe cottage.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: As May gets under way at Longmeadow, Monty Don turns his attention to his 'dry garden', an area where the soil is particularly thin and baked by the sun. He recommends plants which thrive in these conditions.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Horticulturists offer various techniques to elevate the home gardening experience, from repositioning roses in rustic layouts to planning vibrant spring displays.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Staking is the answer when plants grow at such speed and have a tendency to flop.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty Don visits the iconic garden of impressionist painter Claude Monet at Giverny. As well as revelling in the beauty and colour of Monet's paradise at this time of year, he has a privileged chat with Englishman James Priest.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: At Longmeadow, Monty Don shows which plants to choose for sensational borders right through the summer - from ornamental grasses to late flowering perennials. He also plants out squashes and pumpkins, as well as making his own comfrey feed.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty revels in the sweet peas he grew from seed earlier in the year and shows how to keep their display going. Meanwhile, Rachel meets a couple from Hampshire who have created their entire garden around their obsession for one plant, the hosta.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: This show celebrates the arrival of the holiday season. At Longmeadow, Monty ensures that there will be late summer colour by propagating some of his favourites from the fantastically diverse salvia family.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don travels from the north-west coast of Scotland to the north-east coast of England, from historic reconstructions to modern re-inventions. He visits some of the most inhospitable places in the country and finds gardens that are flourishing.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels across some of the country's landscapes, heading across the north of England to Northern Ireland. Here, Monty sees the ingenuity, passion and determination of British people to garden and create gardens, no matter what the canvas.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels across the middle of the country, from Wales to Norfolk. He comes across gardens for gnomes, much-loved, well-tended allotments and extravagant gardens that bankrupted their owners.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don explores the most densely populated part of the country, London and the home counties. He visits some of London's gardens, including a special one on a barge, as well as a beautifully restored garden close to where he grew up in Hampshire.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels across the south-west of the country to visit some of Britain's most exotic gardens. On this journey, Monty also goes to some of the country's most historic gardens, as well as some challenging contemporary ones.

programme.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels to Europe and explores the influence of the Venetians on gardening. To begin with, he explores Venice on one of the city's barges, stepping out to visit green spaces large and small that are often hidden from view behind high walls.

programme.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
programme.desc: Monty begins in the city of Trieste, close to Italy's border with Croatia, to visit a public garden first created by an obsessive royal plantsman more than 150 years ago, which is now being carefully restored.

programme.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
programme.desc: Monty begins the last leg of his journey in Corfu, a Greek island with strong Venetian links, including olive trees planted by them that are still grown today. Here, Monty visits a spectacular garden made by an Englishman with Greek connections.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Join Adam in his garden for a seasonal catch-up. Toby Buckland gives timely tips on summer and autumn maintenance for borders, plus join singer-songwriter Billie Marten as she shares her passion for growing vegetables.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: As the days get shorter, it is a busy time in the garden. Monty Don cracks on with his seasonal tasks at Longmeadow, giving hints and tips along the way. Carol Klein visits first-time gardeners Dan and Dominique for the very last time.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: As autumn unfolds in the garden, Monty Don has plenty to be getting on with at Longmeadow. In his quest to track down some of the nation's most remarkable allotments, Joe Swift visits a tropical paradise in Runcorn.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: With the arrival of October, it is time to start thinking about getting some onions and garlic in the ground, and Monty Don shares his secrets on how to get a successful crop.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty has tips and ideas for planting up garden pots to provide a focal point over the winter months, Rachel visits the tulips of Keukenhof, Joe visits Esther Rantzen's much-loved garden, and Carol visits Glebe Cottage.

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: The team visit Bernadette, a dedicated social worker for troubled adults who has always put the needs of others before her own. Having recently turned sixty, Bernadette finally wants some 'me time': a new garden could give her a well-deserved reward.

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: The team have an unusual challenge: to turn a long, pointed front garden into a water-saving, wildlife-friendly space. Mum Laura wants a place to encourage the bugs and creepy-crawlies that young son William loves.

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: In Salford, the team meet Nicole, who grew up in Germany. She wants to recreate her family's German 'kleine' garden, a traditional community space divided into fruit, veg and lawn.

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: Charlie Dimmock and the Rich brothers Harry and David are in Hook, Hampshire to save young couple Cat and Joel from the garden from hell. These loved-up newlyweds dream of a family garden for the children that they plan to have.

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: The team tackle a vertiginous three-tiered garden. This is no simple back lawn: the garden is so steep that it rises above the roof of the house to offer fantastic views of the local forest and mountain, which the owners want to take advantage of.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Toby Buckland visits the RHS garden at Hyde Hall in Essex for ideas on creating and planting a dry garden, while Carol Klein shows her gardening students how to collect seeds.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty Don is planning ahead and planting autumn-flowering crocus at Longmeadow. Also for autumn colour, he's adding cyclamen to the spring garden, and has tips on how to get a great show from them.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty Don unveils his plans for a wet meadow. He starts by planting herbaceous perennials that will thrive in heavy soils and also look good amidst the long grass. He also pots-on his salvia cuttings.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Rachel de Thame visits the renowned historian Sir Roy Strong at his own garden, The Laskett.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: With bees in mind, Monty Don plans for spring by planting some early nectar sources for them, using bulbs which flower early in the year, namely crocus and winter aconites. He also selects some asters.
